name: Why is AEO particularly important for new dental practices?

mainEntity.name: Why is AEO particularly important for new dental practices?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO is particularly important for new dental practices because it provides a direct path to visibility and patient acquisition in a crowded market. Without a long-standing reputation or extensive patient reviews, new practices can leverage AEO to immediately establish authority by directly answering patient questions. Appearing in featured snippets or voice search results can quickly position a new practice as a credible source of information and services, bypassing some of the traditional hurdles of building an online presence from scratch.
